name: @canvist/web
description: The canvist editor for the browser: a canvas that wraps text exactly like canvist's server-rendered HTML, with typed commands and a font plugin.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_web --target web --profile wasm-web --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-web/wasm --no-pack && rm packages/canvist-web/wasm/.gitignore
